text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Senior year has finally arrived.
As for Mejiro Ardan—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: "—Here's the Twinkle Series Trending News! Next up is a special feature on this person!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: ""Fresh off her widely talked-about success in last year's Classic Year, it's the young lady of the Mejiro family, Mejiro Ardan-san!""

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, her run at the Japanese Derby was simply breathtaking.
Her record after that has been incredible too, so I'm really looking forward to her Senior year—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm honored, but it's a bit embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The public's perception of Mejiro Ardan
was changing drastically after her battles
in the Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When speaking of her, her great sister's name
is no longer brought up. It feels as though she has
firmly established herself as 'Mejiro Ardan'...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text:
"—The main focus will surely be how well she can go toe-to-toe
with Oguri Cap going forward."

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: "Is she truly in a league of her own, after all?"

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: "I believe that would be the proper way to describe it. While many similarly strong and popular Umamusume have emerged this year as well—"

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: "The races she has run, the tracks she has left behind, have always defied all conventional wisdom... and as a fan myself, my heart is always racing."

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text:
"In terms of star power—exciting the crowd, letting them dream—
I believe Oguri Cap has something unlike anything we've seen before."

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: "Fans can't help but keep their eyes on the races she runs and the rivals she faces. She is truly an Umamusume who represents—and defines—this era."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...And so, in the public eye, Oguri Cap was constantly talked about as the centerpiece of the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ――I believe that is the truth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san's running—the brilliance it radiates
is overwhelmingly powerful,
and yet... so alien.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It might sound strange...
but I can't help feeling that this is
"a brilliance destined to go down in history."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...In contrast, "current" me is probably still just a faint, fleeting glimmer
compared to Oguri-san and the mighty rivals who compete alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —That is precisely why I cannot help but wonder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "If someone like me were to shine so brilliantly that it outshined even Oguri and the others—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Wondering just how many people's hearts it would burn to ashes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I may use some rather grandiose words,
but please hear me out without laughing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In this Senior Year, I will reach the pinnacle of "now"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I intend to become the "turning point"
that changes promised history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat Oguri and the others,
and overturn every single assessment
that exists in this current moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I want to make that my future goal.
choice_data_list: ..."The most painful and steepest one," huh?
..."The most painful and steepest one," right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...It is a journey I could never
have made all by myself."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My beloved rivals.
The wonderful races I ran with them.
And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer, who believed in me, walked alongside me,
and guided me to the ‘future’ I stand in today.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—If even one of them were missing,
I don't think I would be standing here
‘right now.’”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Truly... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Would you... be able to come?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A history that all people dream of.
To rewrite every single bit of it, along this "most arduous and rugged" path...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Together, with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing to hesitate over.
As Mejiro Ardan's Trainer, what I must do is already decided.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I'll... tear you to...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
......Heh, hehe, hehehe!
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, I-I'm sorry...!
Your choice of words, Trainer...
It was just a little funny—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still...
fufu, that sounds rather lovely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's so powerful, valiant,
and has such a refreshing feel to it...
I'm almost tempted to use it myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan seemed to like it,
but having her praise me so much
made me the one feeling embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let us aim for it together.
To become history's "turning point"... and its destroyer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, having set our new goal, the Senior year was finally about to begin—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ――Now then, with our goal decided...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let us go on our New Year's shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Mejiro Ardan's invitation,
I visited the shrine—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I always go for the New Year's shrine visit
with those connected to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, this year, I really wanted
to go together with just you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wonder why?
I shall leave that to your imagination, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, there's an opening at the shrine.
Since we're here, why don't we go ahead and pay our respects?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, what will you wish for?
choice_data_list: I hope Aldan can become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...!
You're making a wish on my behalf?
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I was planning to pray for your health too, Trainer,
so does this make us... even?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even so... "May you stay in good health," was it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure...
as long as I'm with you, Trainer,
it will come true."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after finishing their New Year's shrine visit together, they began to move forward with a refreshed mindset...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
You're quite the ambitious one, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall continue to devote myself
so that I, too, may reach the heights
my Trainer expects of me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, you can certainly count on me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after finishing their New Year's shrine visit together, they began to move forward with a refreshed mindset...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No.
I was just a little... surprised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Because that wish had already—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I was thinking of wishing for
Trainer's happiness in the exact same way."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That's why I was so surprised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, shall we both
wish for each other's happiness?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We finish our New Year's shrine visit, wishing for each other's happiness.
And with renewed determination, we begin to move forward...!
